facts.fact: The Government of Benin's national data-exchange dashboard shows an instance with 138,174,337 total requests exchanged, including 32,685,727 in the last 30 days.
The dashboard says the instance has 73 members, 176 information systems and 512 services, with ANATT, ANIP and DGI the top providers.
The dashboard reports 138,174,337 total requests and 57,322,278 requests in the last 12 months, statistics updated 11 July 2026.

slug: 2025-06-23 Benin shares its X-Road-inspired DPI interoperability experience in peer learning webinar

facts.fact: ASIN speakers told a CDPI peer-learning webinar that Benin's UXP interoperability platform, operational since the programme began, enables secure data exchange across government and private entities.
The ASIN speakers said more than 1,500 services are integrated and more than 55 institutions, including banks, telecoms and insurers, are connected to the platform.
The ASIN speakers said over 70 million data exchange transactions have been completed to date.

note: As_of is the webinar article's published date; the figures are 'to date' as spoken.

facts.fact: ANIP's architecture shows an integration and interoperability platform (API, X-Road, PKI) connecting the civil status file, the RNPP and user systems for health, education, social protection, telecoms, banks, tax and public services.
The WURI-Benin coordinator lists interoperability via X-Road among Benin's reforms and reports more than 15.7 million digital authentications performed by ANIP through X-Road.
The deck reports more than 15.7 million digital authentications performed by ANIP via X-Road.

An ASIN staff member's post says Benin's National Interoperability Platform (XROAD BJ), running since 2020, carries data between institutions' systems, as in a vehicle inspection fee query to the tax authority and road-safety agency.
The post gives XROAD BJ counters of 75 public and private members, 193 information systems integrated and 542 active services.
The post reports 205 million secure requests through XROAD BJ, 26.6 million in the last 30 days.
Benin's ID4Africa deck describes the National Interoperability Platform (PNI, XROAD BJ), an X-Road based service bus, as in use, with identity services exposed as secure APIs to third-party systems.

Benin's deck reports successful integration of more than 120 systems through the PNI (XROAD BJ), including the Public Services Portal, the ANIP natural persons registry, e-Tax and Insurance for the Poor.

facts.fact: Cybernetica says the UXP-based secure data exchange platform connecting Beninese government registries was built 2019-2021, was fully up and running in one year, and is still maintained.

Cybernetica says the platform carries more than 3 million monthly information exchanges as of 2024.
A Benin official names a data exchange platform among the foundations of its digital state, beside identity, single portal, e-certificate and payment.
